Mega-Bump.com Affiliate Program

About Our Brand and Products:
Mega-Bump.com offers premium energy drinks and hydrogen-infused water, powered by ENACO-sourced coca powder from Peru’s Andes. Our low-calorie, no-sugar beverages deliver sustained energy and focus, blending ancient coca traditions with modern wellness for health-conscious, active consumers.

What Makes Us Different:
Mega Bump stands out as the first and ONLY energy drink brand using legally sourced, ENACO coca powder, providing a natural, jitter-free energy boost. Unlike typical energy drinks, our product "Hits Harder & Last Longer!" it reflects and honors Andean heritage while offering unmatched stamina and mental clarity.

How Affiliates Can Earn:
Earn competitive commissions up to 20% per sale promoting Mega-Bump Beverage's products. With auto-activated accounts and high-converting products, affiliates enjoy unlimited earning potential. Higher tiers available for top performers, plus bonuses for recruiting new affiliates via our multi-level marketing (MLM) structure.

How to Promote Us: Share your unique affiliate link or coupon code on platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, or email lists. Use our branded banners, social media templates, and product images from the UpPromote portal to create engaging content that drives clicks and conversions, but remember to stay FDA compliant.
Other Information:
Join a fast-growing brand with seamless tracking and timely PayPal payouts. Our affiliate-friendly dashboard simplifies promotion, and our dedicated support ensures your success. Perfect for influencers, bloggers, and marketers passionate about our unique niche in the coca powder industry. Sign up today to start earning with Mega-Bump.com!

Welcome to Mega Bump! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.
These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.


By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration. We may also terminate your participation at any time for non-compliance with these Terms, including but not limited to violations of advertising laws or regulatory guidelines.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers. All promotions must comply with applicable laws, including FTC and FDA guidelines (see Section 8 below).


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).
For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.
Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on 
Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out. We reserve the right to withhold commissions if we suspect fraud or non-compliance with these Terms.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels. You are encouraged to create your own promotional content, provided it complies with Section 8 below.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate. You are responsible for ensuring your downline affiliates comply with these Terms; violations by them may result in your termination.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: megabumpbeverages@gmail.com. We may also remove you at any time for violations, with no obligation to pay pending commissions.


8. Advertsing and Compliance 

You must comply with all applicable laws, including but not limited to FTC guidelines on endorsements and testimonials, FDA regulations on food and beverage claims, and state consumer protection laws. Specifically:
- Disclosures: Clearly disclose your affiliate relationship in all promotions (e.g., #ad, #affiliate, or "I earn commissions from purchases made through this link"). Failure to do so may result in termination.
- Health Claims: Do not make unsubstantiated claims about our products (e.g., no medical, therapeutic, or performance-enhancing claims without our prior written approval). All promotions must align with FDA-approved labeling and avoid implying our energy drinks cure, treat, or prevent any condition.
- Prohibited Practices: No spam, misleading ads, false endorsements, or use of our trademarks in a way that confuses consumers. You may not bid on our brand terms in paid search or use them in domain names.
- Monitoring: We reserve the right to monitor your promotions and require changes or removal. 
Violations may lead to withheld commissions, termination, or legal action.
This ensures compliance with FTC/FDA scrutiny on health products like energy drinks. You are free to create your own content, but it must adhere to these rules to protect both parties.*

9. Indemnification and Liability
You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Mega Bump Beverages, its officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, and suppliers from any claims, losses, damages, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising from your breach of these Terms, including but not limited to violations of advertising laws, FDA/FTC regulations, or intellectual property rights.
We provide the Program "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We disclaim all warranties, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.
In no event shall we be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your participation in the Program, even if advised of the possibility. Our total liability shall not exceed the commissions paid to you in the last 12 months.

10. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the State of Wyoming, without regard to conflict of laws principles. Any disputes arising from these Terms shall be resolved exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Laramie County, Wyoming (or Pinellas County, Florida, at our discretion). You consent to personal jurisdiction in these courts.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to megabumpbeverages@gmail.com for support.
